investigations.name: bird-transport
investigations.title: BiRD reactor transport refactor for cell-engine coupling
investigations.description:
The current BiRDReactorProcess owns biomass internally via a Monod ODE,
which conflicts with a cell engine that also owns biomass; today this is
worked around with a bird_disable_internal_biomass flag. This
investigation replaces that with a single-responsibility split: a shared
transport module, the existing BiRDReactorProcess kept for standalone use
(transport + an extracted MonodCellProcess), and a new BiRDTransportProcess
that takes biomass/substrate/dissolved gas as inputs and emits only the
transport contribution.

The four phases proceed from the refactor (Phase 1, which also yields the
MonodCellProcess that serves as the trivial cell-side fixture per the
cell-side interface contract), to an integration test that the closed
loop fires at impactful biomass (Phase 2), to making the coupling interval
tunable (Phase 3), to supporting the stirred-tank geometry of the target
benchmark (Phase 4). This is the upstream reactor-physics dependency for
the v2ecoli multiscale-bioprocess study mbp-03, which declares
pbg-bioreactor-transport-fork as a hard prerequisite.
